title: Creation (1/15)
description:
Genesis 1:1
In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.(NIV)

title: Ministry of Jesus (2/15)
description:
LUKE 19:9
And Jesus said of him, Today salvation has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham; 10 for the Son of Man (Jesus) has come to seek and to save that which was lost.

title: Sins of Men (3/15)
description:
ROMANS 3:22
Even the righteousness of God which is by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe: for there is no difference: 23 For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God: 24 Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus.

title: Miracle of Jesus 1 (4/15)
description:
MATHEW 10:7 
And as you go, proclaim this message: ‘The kingdom of heaven is near.’ 8 Heal the sick, raise the dead, cleanse the lepers, cast out demons. You have received free, give free.

title: Miracle of Jesus (5/15)
description:
MATTHEW 4:23 
And Jesus went throughout all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all manner of sickness and all manner of disease among the people. 24 And his fame went throughout all Syria: and they brought unto him all that were sick with divers diseases and torments, and them that were possessed with devils, and those that were epileptic, and those that were paralyzed; and he healed them. 25 And great multitudes followed him from Galilee, and from Decapolis, and from Jerusalem, and from Judea, and from beyond Jordan.

title: Judgement of Jesus (6/15)
description:
LUKE 24:45 
Then he opened their minds, that they might understand the Scriptures; 46 and said to them, Thus it is written, and thus it behoved the Christ to suffer, and to rise from the dead the third day, 47 and that repentance for the forgiveness of sins should be preached in his name to all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

title: Crucifixion of Jesus (7/15)
description:
1CORINTHIAN 15:3 
For I delivered to you as of first importance what I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures, 4 that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures, 5 and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve;

title: Resurrection of Jesus (8/15)
description:
LUKE 24:4 
And while they were perplexed about this, behold, two men stood by them in shining garments: 5 And they were afraid, and fell on their faces: and they said unto them, Why seek ye the living among the dead? 6 He is not here, but is risen. Remember how he spake unto you, when he was yet in Galilee, that the Son of man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again. 7 Remember how he spake unto you, when he was yet in Galilee.

title: Second Coming of Jesus (9/15)
description:
2 PETER 3:9 
The Lord is not slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness; but is longsuffering toward you, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance. 10 But the day of the Lord will come as a thief, in which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, and the earth also with the works that are therein shall be burned up. 11 Since these things shall be destroyed, how much more ought ye to be good and righteous, looking for and hastening the coming of the day of God, wherein the heavens being on fire shall pass away, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat? 12 How much more ought ye to be in good works and righteousness, looking for and hastening the coming of that day, that it may come quickly. 13 For we look for new heavens and a new earth, according to his promise, wherein dwelleth righteousness.
